title: We gave a spoiler a mind of its own. Almost.
author: dachi
summary: A final look at the spoiler control electronics before mounting it on the car.
mediaAlt: The active-spoiler electronics and actuator assembly on the bench.
content:
### Pastrana's Subaru GL wagon will soon have a competitor. 

- A custom independent right and left wing control will make our f06 break harder and stay more stable in the corners. 

- two ESP32 board architecture ensure super fast acceleromater reading without interrupting high frequency servo feedback loop. 

- four large DC gearmotors on four-bar wing linkages can deliver enough torque to hold the large pop-up spoiler panels vertically at more then 150kph
